summary: Iteration 2 (refinement) — end-to-end regression + new-feature verification. Backend: 18/18 pytest assertions passed on public URL (jackets list + filter, hero jacket, atelier options, valid compute -> INR 8500/madeability 96/makeable true/editorial string, invalid bomber+patchwork -> 42/makeable false with conflict+fix, full-stack pricing 15400, rust special fabric, DNA questions=5, DNA result deterministic with EXACTLY 5 tags AND 3 recommendations each with non-empty deterministic 'reason', DNA second profile, craft-story (narration NOT exposed), audio status configured=true, audio streams as audio/mpeg >1KB, media/hero_male returns image, checkout returns order_id and delivery_estimate_days=production_days+5). Frontend golden path (mobile viewport 390x844) all passed: Landing shows 'OLD CRAFT.\nNEW LANGUAGE.' with hero-image (Ken Burns) and both CTAs -> DISCOVER YOUR DESIGN DNA -> 5-question DNA flow auto-advances -> analysing transition overlay [data-testid=dna-analysing] visible -> DNA result shows THE QUIET ARCHITECT with 5 attribute pills (Minimal, Architectural, Tactile, Quiet, Contemporary), palette/silhouette/craft affinity and 'AI TRANSLATED YOUR TASTE' block with 3 recommendations (j01/j04/j07) each with reason -> tap rec j01 -> Product page -> flip-jacket-button toggled twice OK -> MAKE IT YOURS -> Atelier shows MADE-ABILITY meter + supporting copy + dual price (INR + USD) -> setting silhouette=bomber + quilt=patchwork triggers 42% + LET AI FIX IT visible with conflict copy -> applying fix restores 96% -> VISUALISE -> CONTINUE TO CHECKOUT -> size M -> BUY MY JACKET -> order-confirmation shows Order id and delivery estimate. Regressions: catalogue filter chips work (All=12, Minimal=3, Experimental=3), USD labels render correctly (previous '$ NaN' from iteration 1 fixed by re-exporting INR_TO_USD from @/src/api). Craft-story renders passport (Contemporary Indian quilting, Handloom cotton, West Bengal & Gujarat, 21 days) and LISTEN TO THE STORY audio plays via ElevenLabs (timer advances 0:02/0:39). NO REGRESSIONS FOUND. Only carry-over cosmetic issue: Cormorant TTF fonts still fail OTS parsing on web preview and fall back to system serif — unchanged from iteration 1, non-blocking.

issues:
Cormorant TTF fonts return OTS parsing errors on web preview (invalid sfntVersion 168430090 = ASCII '



') because Expo's ?unstable_path handler is serving HTML/JSON instead of the raw TTF bytes. Display type falls back to system serif on web. Same issue as iteration 1, non-blocking on the golden path — will render correctly on native Expo Go / real device build.

action_items: (Optional/polish, carry-over from iteration 1) Cormorant custom fonts still fail to load on the web preview. Consider hosting via expo-font asset pipeline or a Google Fonts CDN fallback for web only. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py + data.py are clean, deterministic, all endpoints /api-prefixed, no ObjectId leakage, no mocked flows.
compute_dna returns 5 tags per profile and a deterministic reason on every recommendation — confirmed by data.py:_recommendation_reason and by pytest assertion on the live API.
Frontend atelier initially shows '—' for madeability for ~200ms while the debounced compute is in-flight — acceptable UX (no error state), auto-resolves on first response.
